definition: Composite prime_award_key | subaward_number | action_date. The de-duplication key across FSRS restatements (keep the latest report_last_modified).
Generated unique id of the prime award the subaward sits under. For inbound rows this award usually belongs to ANOTHER organization.
FAIN or PIID of the prime award. Agencies reuse these.
UEI of the prime recipient - the pass-through entity. On search-fetched rows filled from the Prime Award Recipient UEI field.
Legal name of the prime recipient.
UEI of the prime's parent registration.
UEI of the first-tier subrecipient. Often null for government subawardees in bulk files; on search-fetched rows stamped from the query because the search view returns it null.
Legal name of the subrecipient.
UEI of the subrecipient's parent registration.
The prime's own identifier for the subaward. Format can differ between USAspending views.
sub-grant or sub-contract.
Committed subaward dollars. A commitment not a disbursement; subawards under the 30k USD FSRS threshold are unreported so totals are a floor.
When the subaward was committed. The date flows are booked on.
Calendar year of subaward_action_date.
Federal fiscal year of subaward_action_date. Recomputed.
FSRS reporting period year. Lags the action - sometimes across fiscal years. Bulk files only.
FSRS reporting period month. Bulk files only.
When the FSRS report was last restated. The restatement tiebreaker. Bulk files only.
The prime award's lifetime obligation - context for pass-through share.
The prime award's lifetime outlays.
Agency behind the prime award.
Assistance listing(s) behind the prime award.
in / out / internal / unrelated relative to the organization's UEI set. NA in a raw extract; assigned by us_normalize_subawards(). Only out is subtracted from revenue.
Provenance: bulk CSV name or api:spending_by_award:subawards[_in].
